sql: WITH alvo AS (SELECT m.conversation_id, m.timestamp FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id JOIN wapi_instances w ON w.id = c.instance_id JOIN companies co ON co.id = w.company_id WHERE co.name ILIKE '%mega%magic%' AND m.content LIKE 'Janeiro, ótima escolha%' AND m.timestamp >= now() - interval '7 days') SELECT c.remote_jid, c.bot_step, c.bot_data->>'mes' AS mes, m.from_me, to_char(m.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI:SS') AS hora, left(m.content, 50) AS texto, encode(convert_to(left(m.content, 12), 'UTF8'), 'hex') AS hex, m.message_type, (SELECT use_flow_builder FROM wapi_bot_settings b WHERE b.instance_id = c.instance_id) AS flow_builder FROM alvo a JOIN wapi_messages m ON m.conversation_id = a.conversation_id AND m.timestamp BETWEEN a.timestamp - interval '6 minutes' AND a.timestamp + interval '1 minute' JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id ORDER BY c.remote_jid, m.timestamp
